visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side layout of two or more content columns, typically text next to an image
visualCharacteristics.layout: Columns stack on mobile in authored order; from 900px they sit side by side, vertically centred, text 40% / image 60%. An image column holding two pictures shows them side by side (portrait 2:3, last one rounded bottom-right). A single image is cropped 3:2 with a rounded bottom-left corner. Inside a dark-blue section the title and copy are smaller and inset.
behavior: Adds `columns-<n>-cols` to the block, where n is the number of cells in the first row.
A cell whose only content is a picture (or a paragraph of pictures) gets `columns-img-col`; with two or more pictures they are lifted out of the paragraph and the cell also gets `columns-img-group`.
A short paragraph directly above a heading at the start of a cell gets `columns-eyebrow` (small uppercase label).
Two or more consecutive button links in a cell are grouped in `.columns-buttons`; every button after the first that is not bold becomes a `tertiary` text link with an arrow.

contentPattern.structure: one or more rows, each row with one cell per column; cells hold free content (headings, paragraphs, links, images)

cells.name: column
cells.content: any default content: heading, paragraphs, links, picture(s)

notes: Use the same number of cells in every row; the column count is taken from the first row.
Put several pictures in one cell (nothing else) to show an image pair.
Put two links on separate lines to get a button plus a text link.

usage: Use for text-plus-image promo panels and other two-column layouts. Put section colours (such as dark-blue) in section metadata, not on the block.
reuseGuidance: Has no options. Spacing and background come from the section style.
